children.name: MFA_ENABLED
children.description: Emitted when an MFA factor is enabled for an auth identity.

children.name: MFA_DISABLED
children.description: Emitted when an MFA factor is disabled for an auth identity.

children.name: MFA_RECOVERY_CODES_GENERATED
children.description: Emitted when recovery codes are generated for an auth identity.

children.name: PASSWORD_RESET
children.description:
Emitted when a reset password token is generated. You can listen to this event
to send a reset password email to the user or customer, for example.

children.name: VERIFICATION_REQUESTED
children.description:
Emitted when a verification code is generated. You can listen to
this event and decide how to deliver the code to the user or customer.
